human_feedback.diagnosis: Wallet looks generic and AI-generated despite sharing some visual elements with Mining. Mining communicates philosophy with intentional negative space, a living blue circulation metaphor, and subtle intuitive hierarchy; Wallet relies on redundant copy and generic website structure.
human_feedback.desired_translation: Clean, spacious, restrained, intuitively communicative; Wallet communicates sovereignty and calm while Mining communicates active participation. Translate the artistic identity without mechanically cloning Mining.

source_grounded_audit.mining: Instrument composition, generous space, large primary metric, causal blue activity trace, fine rules, restrained labels.
source_grounded_audit.wallet: Oversized marketing-like heading, explanatory paragraphs, state-switch sidebar, admission-rule copy, four-column composition notes, repeated headings and generic form/card language.

requirements: Replace generic marketing hero with instrument-like wallet presence and meaningful negative space.
Empty state: explicit New Wallet and Recover Wallet actions; no implicit creation.
Active state: balance and identity as quiet primary instrument; Send and Receive immediately discoverable.
Use blue only for genuine activity/state transitions; no fake heartbeat or decorative ambient loop.
History as restrained ledger; recovery as focused precise secure flow.
Preserve accessibility, mobile behavior, cryptography, address and transaction semantics.
Validate desktop/mobile side by side with frozen Mining Studio before asking for renewed acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Visual rejection does not invalidate existing functional test passes; previous technical readiness must not be represented as artistic acceptance.
